name: Juan Atkins
description: '''Juan Atkins''' (September 12, 1962 – October 31, 2026), also known as '''Model 500''' and '''Infiniti''', was an American record producer and DJ. ''[[Mixmag]]'' has described him as "the original pioneer of [[Detroit techno]]". He was at different times a member of [[the Belleville Three]], [[Cybotron (American band)|Cybotron]] and Borderland.
